title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Poorest States Inclusive Growth (PSIG) Programme

description.narrative: This activity Technical Assistance for Poorest States Inclusive Growth (PSIG) Programme is a component of Poorest States Inclusive Growth Programme reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £27,561,862. It works in the following sector(s): Informal/semi-formal financial intermediaries, Financial policy and administrative management, Formal sector financial intermediaries, Business policy and administration, Education/training in banking and financial services.
